propositions: The criterion_prompt_id resolver hardcodes the plan-review prompt prefix, so code-review criteria resolve into the plan-review prompt namespace.
A keyword-only gate_key parameter defaulting to plan_review is added so the resolver selects the prompt prefix per gate.
A _PROMPT_PREFIX map routes plan_review to plan-review- and code_review to code-review- prefixes.
An unknown gate_key value raises CriteriaError.
The plan_review default preserves existing behavior byte-for-byte so existing callers need no change.
Code-review project ids remain injective and do not collide with any plan-review physical id.
